network.lane_carry.enable false.  SH stays deg-8 + layer-2 deg-4 so the delta is

everything else, and the whole window sits inside ignition.  What it CAN show:
wall per epoch, PD-fold health, carried-DD population, largest component size,
post-fit sigma0_code, and whether anything breaks.  Grade against the SAME first
30 epochs of runs/agu63, never against its converged hours.
